_comment: Deterministic enforcement layer. A skill can only ask an agent to follow a rule;
a PreToolUse hook makes the rule architectural — it cannot be reasoned around.
Every rule here already exists in prose in a foundation skill, so the hooks add
guard-noise-reads   -> meta/token-discipline  (never read dependency trees or build output)
guard-new-dependency-> meta/engineering-principles (a new dep must clear a bar)
Deliberately NOT hooks/hooks.json: that path is auto-discovered for every plugin
in this marketplace, and enforcement must stay opt-in. The `enforcement` plugin
Every hook fails open: any error, missing node, or unexpected payload exits 0
with no decision, so a broken hook never blocks work.
